items.title_orig: Rejuvenation, A Playlist Inspired By Each Of The 38 Deadlock Heroes Including 38 Songs From 38 Different Artists
items.article_text:
Hi Reddit. I love the heroes from Valve's new, not yet fully released, game Deadlock. For some reason the stories these devs crafted for each hero have stuck with me, and explaining my fascination with them would glaze their creators far more than they are probably comfortable with. So without further ado, these are some songs that I both enjoy and can't help but align with the characters from this great game.
 This playlist contains mostly rock music, sprinkling in some more experimental songs here and there. I've included sort-of explanations for each track below.
 Here it is on YouTube Music.
  
 Abrams - Bombing Out by Jack White
